offres.lieu: Zagreb - Heinzelova ulica 70; Sofia; Belgrade; Croatia
offres.extrait:
Job Description & Summary 
 PwC is looking for a Senior Associate or Associate in Management Consulting to join our Energy, Utilities and Resources (EU&R) consulting practice in Southeast Europe. 
 This is a client-facing consulting role for candidates who can structure problems, analyze data, develop recommendations, independently manage project workstreams and stay up to date with latest energy trends – not a specialized sales / commercial, PMO or technical-execution role (e.g. GHG specialist, EIA specialist, technical engineer). 
 What You’ll Do 
- Support strategy, transformation and performance-improvement projects for energy, utilities and resources clients, covering energy transition, renewable energy, power and gas markets, energy infrastructure, decarbonisation and new energy solutions 
- Identify improvements in operating models, processes, governance, data use and technology enablement across energy and utility organizations 
- Develop business cases, feasibility studies and market-entry strategies 
- Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses, translating complex findings via problem structuring into clear business implications and client-ready recommendations

 Strategy& - Business Strategy focus Energy, Utilities and Resources - Senior Associate - Milano

Strategy& | Our History 
In 1914 Strategy& (formerly Booz & Co.) started the world’s first management consulting Firm. Over a century later our mission continues to be to deliver strategy-led, technology-enabled transformation for our clients. 
100-year legacy in solving the world’s toughest strategy problems, pragmatically. 
Strategy& was born in 2014 when Booz & Company became part of the PwC network, joining forces to create a new kind of consulting business – one that combines strategic expertise with the technology and scale to make strategy real. As part of the PwC Network, we are able to leverage the full offering of the largest professional services network in the world, enabling true comprehensive transformation for our clients. 
The result is a unique offering, able to deliver strategy consulting from the platform of a multi-services professional network that has a 250-year history of working with the leading private, public, and non-profit organizations around the Globe.

 Our US Marketplace Strategy & Operations team is responsible for building, scaling and improving the way in which we provide Restaurant delivery. We build our restaurant selection, test 0 → 1 products to give merchants more opportunity to delight their consumers, and optimize ways to improve our marketplace to increase the return on investment our partners gain from partnering with DoorDash. This team focuses on all things Restaurants ranging from selection, to merchandising, to consumer strategy, to leveraging our logistics network in new ways, to so much more! 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a Senior Associate to join our Marketplace Strategy & Operations team, with a focus on Restaurant Growth. This team is dedicated to growing our restaurant marketplace by launching new selection, enhancing in-app merchandising, helping negotiate new merchant partnerships, and commercializing products that help our restaurant partners grow their businesses on DoorDash.
